### Changed
- **Try all of Pro for 7 days** instead of three tries of each Pro feature. The week starts when you say so: the first time you try a Pro feature, at the end of onboarding, from the menu bar or in Settings › License. Whatever you asked for goes on right after you start it. On 0.6.0 and used your tries? The week is yours to start. - **Buy Pro** opens the checkout right away. - Toasts appear at the top right, where macOS shows its notifications; a click puts one away.
### Added
- **Remove Background** in the editor (toolbar, or the Background panel): the person or thing on a capture stays, the rest is transparent — or on a background you pick. Crop to Subject in one click; ⌘Z brings the background back. A JPEG capture is saved as a PNG, so the transparency is kept. - **Faces** beside the secrets: turn on Settings › Secrets › Faces, and faces in photos, video calls and avatars are listed in the Text panel to pixelate. Only where a face is: DeepSnap never tells whose. - **Actions** on what a capture shows: an address opens in Maps, a phone number calls, a date becomes a Calendar event, a link or an e-mail address opens — in the editor's Text panel and in the history. - **Unsaved** in the history's sidebar: captures still on a thumbnail, and those you dropped into another app without saving (kept a day). Save one to put it in your folder and the history. - **Keys as in macOS** in Settings › Shortcuts: ⌘⇧3 the screen, ⌘⇧4 an area, ⌘⇧5 a window, ⌘⇧R recording. DeepSnap says how to turn off macOS's own screenshot shortcuts and takes the keys as soon as you come back. - A capture shortcut works while a DeepSnap menu is open, and the menu is in the picture. - Click a secret or a face in the Text panel to see where it is: the rest of the picture dims. - The editor opens with the last tool you drew with, or one you choose in Settings › Capture › Editor.
### Fixed
- Compression progress counts each pass from 0 to 100 % — on a long recording it looked stuck at 5 %. - A handle such as @JohnSmith-cc7xw is no longer taken for a password.
